notes:
## New features

- Choose Free field / incident or Façade sound levels for individual receptors. Free-field results retain environmental reflections while excluding the receiving façade's final reflection; the selected convention is retained in saved results and exports.
- Compare reflection orders for selected or all receptors from Results → More → Reflection order sensitivity. Comparisons run in the background on a copy of the model and can be exported for review.

## Changes

- New ISO projects enable environmental reflections at order 3, with orders 1–20 available. Existing projects retain their saved settings. Third order is a starting preset, not a guarantee of convergence or a UK-wide prescribed setting.
- Interpolation choices now stop at 16×. Older higher-density selections, including SmartSmooth worker settings, migrate to 16× without changing the calculated grid.
- Clarify single-value source inputs: the entered overall power uses the ISO 9613-2:2024 500 Hz attenuation estimate. Explicit spectra propagate by octave band; third-octave inputs are combined energetically into octave bands.
- Clarify source emission directivity, reference Q for Lp-to-Lw conversion and environmental reflections to help avoid counting the same wall enhancement twice. Manufacturer data containing installation corrections still require an appropriate modelling basis.
- Contours remain interpolated approximations. Check grid refinement and exact receptor levels near reflection eligibility boundaries; a localized P1997 audit retained approximately 1.55 dB interpolation error at a 0.125 m grid near a verified finite-reflector cutoff. Reflection-order sensitivity is separate from grid accuracy and does not bound untested higher-order contributions.
- Verification covers focused acoustic, presentation, persistence and native workflow checks. A historical T19 250 Hz reference discrepancy remains an explicit open validation case. This release does not claim complete ISO conformity, higher-order cylindrical reflection support or automatic source-installation correction removal. The macOS installer uses the existing ad-hoc signing channel and is not Apple-notarized.

## Bug fixes

- Sum all eligible reflected paths through the selected order instead of stopping after the first two. Correct intermediate-face selection for multiple reflections and evaluate source directivity towards each path's first reflection point.
- Stop explicitly when the reflection-search budget is exhausted instead of returning a partial reflected result. Accelerate eligible-path searches without changing the accepted sums in the audited cases.
- Use the same single-value attenuation basis in receptor, contour and legacy-input routes, and pass directional source data into contour transition diagnostics.
- Invalidate cached contour calculations when the reflection implementation or single-value basis changes, while retaining historical saved results with their original evidence.
- Handle a single discovered contour transition segment and give tiled threshold samples distinct cache identities.
- Wait for the selected interpolated presentation before permitting export, preventing an unfinished view from being exported after reopening a project.
- Keep the progress indicator active while a completed acoustic grid is switching to its selected contour presentation.
- Preserve the editor camera during delayed startup and immediate undo, and cancel pending startup update callbacks when their window is destroyed.
